identity._identity_note: HARDWARE-CONFIRMED 2026-10-19: this physical Cutebot Pro board answers HELLO with name=zetuv, serial=1468666101 (registry short uid 312bde85), tethered to host 'torture' on /dev/ttyACM0. It was tentatively assigned 'zeguz' during sprint 040 (never hardware-cross-checked); per that config's own instruction ('if the board answers zetuv, rename to config/robots/zetuv.json and recompute radio for that name'), this file supersedes config/robots/zeguz.json for this board. Identity comes from silicon, per this fleet's identity-comes-from-hardware-not-config rule.

connection._radio_note: Derived from the board name 'zetuv' per radio-robot-lib docs/design/radio-addressing.md (channel 11 + n%73, group 15 + n%241), computed via tools/make_deploy.py derive_radio_from_name('zetuv') -> (49, 250). CONFIRMED against the live board's own STATUS reply (channel=49 group=250) on 2026-10-19.

firmware_bake._provenance: ZETUV-MEASURED 2026-10-20/21, fleet firmware with the Cutebot defaults (onboard_pid 0, pid_kp 2, pid_ki 15, pid_max 9000, pid_i_max 9000, pos_err_max 200, arrive_yaw 2) over zilch. travel_calib 0.441: mean of eleven calwheels runs over the 90.2 cm track with those gains (0.4396-0.4435 mm/deg, sd ~0.3 %). trackwidth 91: camera-measured centre pivots (86-94 mm). rotational_slip 1.055: tuned so camera-measured MOVE_X 90 deg turns average 90 (two 50 cm square laps close within 3 cm); calturn's continuous-spin result (0.976) disagrees by 8 % and is not used.

geometry._note: travel_calib, trackwidth and rotational_slip measured 2026-10-20 (see firmware_bake._provenance). Still unmeasured: lag_s, stop_distance_mm.

vision._units_note: Same conventions as gopiv.json: offsets in MILLIMETRES from the centre of rotation (x forward, y left); tag_offset_yaw is the FULL mount yaw in DEGREES.
vision._provenance: ZETUV-MEASURED 2026-10-21 on the main playfield (arducam-ov9782): tag 58 is zetuv's long-term tag (Eric), height 112 mm (Eric). Yaw from a 10 cm forward move against the tag heading; x/y from two pivots (161.7 and -81.7 deg) solved for the centre of rotation: x 5.8/4.8 mm, y -1.0/+2.8 mm. y is recorded as 0 (on the centre line; the measured value is inside camera noise). Registered live with register_tag (mount_y 0.9 mm at the time).
